findings.title: No regression test verifies SQL expressions are rejected with the feature flag enabled
findings.body: This change is the security boundary that disables SQL expressions, but no test is added for `ReadQuery` receiving `QueryTypeSQL` while `FlagSqlExpressions` is enabled. The implementation intentionally returns false regardless of toggle state; without a test covering the enabled-toggle case, a future cleanup that restores the usual feature-toggle logic could silently re-enable the vulnerable SQL execution path.
